text:
deploy-bot: Promotion queued for chart: service-invoice v3.2.0 -> v3.3.0. Pre-promotion checks: values checksum changed, detected image tag 'release-202603' with two distinct digests in registry. Promotion paused pending manual resolution.

diane: ack. seeing the duplicate tag too. which digest did QA certify?

eric: QA ran against sha256:bb22...aa11 (pushed yesterday). registry shows another push (sha256:cc33...dd44) at 04:12 UTC.

maria: if we pick the wrong one we might regress a hotfix included in the later image. Not great.

ops-lead: tradeoffs: 1) hold promotion, 2) pin to older digest (bb22...), 3) promote with override and force-canary-smoke. my preference is pin to QA digest then run extended smoke.

release-engineer: can we do a small values overlay change to explicitly set `image.digest` and add `release.redwood/extended-smoke: "true"` so deploy-bot runs 10m longer?

diane: yes can open PR right now to overlays/invoice/pin-image.yaml. it's a one-line change.

eric: also suggest adding `helm.redwood/allow-promotion: "pin-invoice-923"` annotation so deploy-bot knows the intent.

release-engineer: I'll coordinate the annotation after PR merge. Diane, please link PR here.

diane: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/invoice/PR-923 — sets `image.digest: sha256:bb22...aa11` and comment about duplicate tag.

maria: CI: chart-lint ok, unit tests ok, but integration job failing flakily (times out in 2 runs).

ops-lead: hmm integration flakiness is concerning. If integration fails against the canary we should not continue. Can we run smoke locally once pinned?

eric: deploy-bot: created locked candidate `pin-invoice-923`. To continue add annotation or run `/deploy override pin-invoice-923` by @release-engineer.

release-engineer: executing `/deploy override pin-invoice-923` now.

deploy-bot: Override accepted from @release-engineer. Starting canary (3% traffic) eu-central. Extended smoke enabled (10m).

(smoke output)
```
2026-04-12T09:02:10Z  health OK
2026-04-12T09:07:12Z  invoice-db connection error: timeout
2026-04-12T09:07:13Z  retrying...
```

maria: saw that DB timeout at T+5m during smoke. traces show spike in DB query latency.

eric: is this the same symptom we saw in yesterday's staging run? might be query plan regression.

diane: can't promote with DB errors. rollback? or pause and fix query?

ops-lead: decision: abort promotion, roll back the candidate to keep current stable. open a postmortem ticket and pin the PR for later.

release-engineer: running `/deploy cancel pin-invoice-923` and initiating rollback to v3.2.0.

deploy-bot: Promotion aborted. Rollback executed. v3.2.0 remains live. Lockfile `pin-invoice-923` closed as aborted.

maria: filing follow-up: create issue #INFRA-612 to add integration retries and clearer DB latency alert during canary. Also mark PR-923 as blocked pending query investigation.

diane: noted. I'll add a comment to PR.

eric: thanks everyone. we'll retest after the query fix and re-run canary next window. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
